text: HSBC reports $29.91B annual pre-tax profit, down 7.4% year on year, with revenue up 4% to $68.27B, both above estimates. Operating expenses increase 8% amid restructuring and technology costs. Hang Seng privatization completed; payroll cost reduction target near 8% with managing director roles reduced 15%.

meta.note: One-off disposal gains affect quarterly comparison; headcount targets not fully specified.
